All tables are tab-separated text files (one JSON file) in the \texttt{results\_tables/} folder of the repository (\url{https://github.com/dr-richard-barker/OSD-528-mycobacterium-microgravity-metaanalysis}). \section*{Supplementary figures}

\begin{figure}[h]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{Supplementary_Figure_S1_sensitivity_RFPRPM4}
\caption*{\textbf{Supplementary Figure S1. Sensitivity analysis with the inferred RFPRPM4 library.} \textbf{a}, PCA of all \nSamplesDeposited{} samples, including the inferred RFPRPM4 library (bold). \textbf{b}, RPM vs static 1g fold changes with and without RFPRPM4 (Pearson $r=\rLfcRpmSens$); colours show where each gene is a DEG. Including RFPRPM4 gives \nDegRpmSens{} RPM DEGs, compared with \nDegRpm{} in the primary analysis.}
\end{figure}

\begin{figure}[h]
\centering
\includegraphics[width=\textwidth]{Supplementary_Figure_S2_go_wgcna_modules}
\caption*{\textbf{Supplementary Figure S2. GO enrichment of the WGCNA modules.} Up to three GO terms per module at BH FDR $<0.05$ (hypergeometric test against all network genes with annotation); labels give genes in the module / annotated genes in the term.}
\end{figure}
